attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yfaP`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 87% of calls. The model names 96% of them, at 0.09 bits.

**A variable stretch follows at columns 1 to 6**, `atoB` to `atoS`, carried by 77 to 82%, [[acetate CoA-transferase]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 93%, and hesitates less there, 0.22 against 0.27 bits. Its most hesitant column, 34, `yejO`, is a fork column, at 0.94 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 61 to 79, `yeiL` to `yeiS`, are carried by 5 to 89%, fewest named at column 64, 59%. The last column is `yeiS`, in 78% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 95% of genes**, 0.24 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.85 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 80% against 97%.

label: yfaP
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yfaP window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yfaP, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,487 to 1,566 from dnaA. Read in 525 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yfaP once); 42,000 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.24 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,926 calls, named 98%, 0.14 bits; shell 4,692 calls, named 83%, 0.76 bits; cloud 382 calls, named 17%, 3.33 bits. Outside an RGP 37,477 calls, named 97%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 4,523 calls, named 80%, 0.85 bits. Columns: 50 spine, 3 fork, 27 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.85 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 97%); 4,523 of the 42,000 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 34 (yejO, a fork column) 0.94 bits, RGP 10%; column 35 (yejM, a spine column) 0.90 bits, RGP 10%; column 17 (yojO, a spine column) 0.72 bits, RGP 1%. The 7 columns (columns 0-6) where most calls are in an RGP: named 95%, 0.26 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 95%, 0.24 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 50 spine columns: named 97%, 0.22 bits on average; the 30 fork and variable columns: named 93%, 0.27 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 34, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 0 (spine), RGP 87%; the least: columns 7-33 (spine), RGP 1-4%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 87%. Genes: yfaP "YfaP family protein". named 96%; 0.09 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-6 (6 columns) variable: share 77-82%, all S, RGP 73-87%. named 88-99% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1, named 88%, 0.71 bits.
[S2.c1-6]    columns 1-6, share 77-82%, all S: atoB 79%, atoE 82%, atoA "acetate CoA-transferase subunit beta" 82%, atoD 82%, atoC 78%, atoS 77%
[S3] 3. columns 7-33 (27 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 1-4%. Genes: rcsC "two-component system sensor histidi…", rcsB, rcsD, ompC, apbE, ada, alkB, yojI "microcin J25 efflux ABC transporter…", mqo, eco, yojO "protein YojO", napF, napD, napA, napG, napH, napB "nitrate reductase cytochrome c-type…", napC, ccmA, ccmB, ccmC, ccmD, ccmE, ccmF "cytochrome c-type biogenesis heme l…", dsbE, ccmH, narP. named 96-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 13 (alkB), named 96%; most hesitant at column 17 (yojO), 0.72 bits.
[S4] 4. column 34 fork: share 72%, all S, RGP 10%. named 88%; 0.94 bits.
[S4.c34]    34: yejO S 72% "autotransporter YejO"; also "IS1 family transposase" S 15%
[S5] 5. columns 35-46 (12 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 9-10%. Genes: yejM "LPS biosynthesis-modulating metallo…", yejL "YejL family protein", yejK "nucleoid-associated protein YejK", rplY, radD, rsuA, bcr, yejG "YejG family protein", yejF "microcin C ABC transporter ATP-bind…", yejE "ABC transporter permease", yejB "microcin C ABC transporter permease…", yejA "extracellular solute-binding protein". named 89-95% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 35 (yejM), named 89%, 0.90 bits.
[S6] 6. column 47 variable: share 90%, all P, RGP 9%. named 93%; 0.47 bits.
[S6.c47]    47: pdeN P 90%
[S7] 7. columns 48-53 (6 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 3-8%. Genes: mepS, lpxT, yeiR "zinc-binding GTPase YeiR", yeiQ "mannitol dehydrogenase family prote…", yeiP "elongation factor P-like protein Ye…", yeiW "YkgJ family cysteine cluster protein". named 95-98% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 48 (mepS), named 95%, 0.29 bits.
[S8] 8. column 54 variable: share 89%, all P, RGP 3%. named 96%; 0.25 bits.
[S8.c54]    54: setB P 89%
[S9] 9. columns 55-57 (3 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: fruB, fruK, fruA "PTS fructose transporter subunit II…". named 93-97% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 57 (fruA), named 93%, 0.24 bits.
[S10] 10. columns 58-59 (2 columns) variable: share 88-89%, all P, RGP 2%. named 91-94% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 58, named 91%, 0.32 bits.
[S10.c58]    58: psuK P 88%
[S10.c59]    59: psuG P 89% "pseudouridine-5'-phosphate glycosid…"
[S11] 11. column 60 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: psuT. named 96%; 0.21 bits.
[S12] 12. columns 61-79 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: share 5-89%, 18 P, 1 S, RGP 1-4%. named 59-97% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 64, named 59%; most hesitant at column 69, 0.47 bits.
[S12.c61-76]    columns 61-76 variable, share 5-89%, 15 P, 1 S: yeiL "transcriptional regulator YeiL" 87%, rihB 89%, nuoA 5%, yeiI "sugar kinase" 88%, nfo 88%, yeiH "YeiH family protein" 88%, yieE "DNA-binding transcriptional regulat…" 88%, lysP 87%, cirA 80%, yeiG "S-formylglutathione hydrolase" 86%, folE 86%, yeiB "DUF418 domain-containing protein Ye…" 84%, galS 84%, mglB 84%, mglA 83%, mglC "galactose/methyl galactoside ABC tr…" 82%
